title: Exact Binary Search
summary: Locate a target in a sorted list.
statement: Return the index of `target` in ascending `nums`, or -1 when it is absent. Values are unique.
hints: Discard half of the remaining range after every comparison.
Keep inclusive left and right boundaries.
When nums[mid] is too small, move left to mid + 1; otherwise move right.
The interval closes when left passes right.
editorial: Maintain an inclusive search interval. Comparing its middle element determines which half can still contain the target.

tests.explanation: The target 9 is present at zero-based index 4.
The target falls between 0 and 3 but is not present, so return -1.
